telegraph_chain: lane tint marks the threatened path
impact or clean-avoid feedback resolves the beat

waypoints.purpose: Establish lane anchors and safe first pickup.
Teach lane change and isolated jump barrier.
Combine lane threats, barriers and Pulse decisions.
Give a short recovery window before climax.
Resolve the final pursuer attack pattern and reach the gate.

gates.telegraph: Pulse meter glows and pulse-ready cue plays.

gates.unlock_condition: Survive through frame 4500 with integrity above zero and pressure below 100.
gates.telegraph: Horizon gate brightens through the climax palette transition.

optional_routes.reward: Extra celestial energy and two points of pressure relief.
Five Pulse energy and three points of pressure relief.

risk_markers.telegraph: Low bright shard silhouette appears 48 frames before collision.
Threatened lane receives a warm floor flare 36 frames before activation.
Pursuer impact frame and lane flare align 28 frames before collision.
Pressure meter, warmer palette accents and danger cue cadence increase together.

breathing_zones.purpose: Provide one safe pickup and a readable pause before the final attack sequence.

phase_rhythm_map.fidelity_target: clear tutorial readability and cool palette
paired threats, warm accents and visible pursuer growth
pursuer impacts, high contrast and stable obstacle readability

tutorial_invisible_beats.delivery: Spawn the first pickup in the starting lane without threats.
Spawn the next pickup in one adjacent lane.
Spawn one low barrier with both adjacent lanes safe.

tutorial_invisible_beats.teaches: B spends a full Pulse meter.
tutorial_invisible_beats.delivery: Glow the meter, play the ready cue and follow with a paired threat.

environmental_narrative_map.story_beat: The road still protects the runner at the beginning.

environmental_narrative_map.element: warmer sky accents and pursuer growing on the horizon
environmental_narrative_map.story_beat: The ancient hart is closing the distance.

environmental_narrative_map.element: bright gate and stabilized road lines

failure_recovery_model.reset_strategy: Result state accepts A or START and re-enters APP_SCENE_CHASE with all static pools reset.
failure_recovery_model.death_punishment: The current 75-second attempt is lost; no persistent progress is removed.

acceptance_tests.scenario: Play from start without reading any instructions.
acceptance_tests.expected: Three lanes, incoming threats and the final gate remain visually readable.
Lane change, jump and Pulse each provide a meaningful advantage at least once.
Each hit was visibly telegraphed before failure and the result offers immediate restart.

acceptance_tests.scenario: Pause and resume in every phase, then reach victory and failure results.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every state has a deterministic continuation path.
